lanPanel.copyFailed: Failed to copy to clipboard. Please try again.
lanPanel.intro: Connect both devices to the same Wi‑Fi: show a QR code on one device and scan it with the other to transfer books and reading data.
lanPanel.paste: Paste connection info from the other device
lanPanel.paste.placeholder: Paste connection info copied from the other device
lanPanel.help.sameWifi: Ensure both devices are on the same Wi‑Fi, or connected to the same mobile hotspot.
lanPanel.help.guestNetwork: Corporate, school, hotel networks, and router "guest networks" often block device-to-device connections. Try a mobile hotspot.
lanPanel.help.firewall: If a firewall prompt appears on your computer, please allow access.
lanPanel.bindIp: Advanced: specify local IP address (usually not needed)
lanPanel.qrFailed: Failed to display QR code. Click "Copy connection info" below and paste it on the other device.
lanPanel.scanThis: Scan this QR code with the other device
lanPanel.step.open: On the other device, open "Shelf Settings → Device Transfer"
lanPanel.step.scan: Select "Scan QR Code" and point at this QR code
lanPanel.send.selectHint: Want to send only a few books? Use "Batch Select" on the shelf first, then click "Send to Device".
lanPanel.send.includeBooks.on: The other device can open and read immediately; takes longer for many books
lanPanel.send.includeBooks.off: Send reading data only; the other device must already have the book files
lanPanel.send.note: Always includes reading data: progress, bookmarks, notes, favorites, and folders. All Books includes empty folders; selected books only includes relevant folders.
lanPanel.waitPeer: Or wait for the other device to send
lanPanel.offer.hint: After receiving, an import preview will be shown before writing to the library.
lanPanel.progress.committing: Almost done. Closing the panel now will not interrupt the process; the shelf will update automatically.
lanPanel.skipped.other: {count} book files were not found; only their reading data was sent.
lanPanel.skipped.one: {count} book file was not found; only its reading data was sent.
lanPanel.sent.title: Transfer Complete
lanPanel.sent.imported.other: The other device has imported {count} books.
lanPanel.sent.imported.one: The other device has imported {count} book.
lanPanel.sent.received: The other device has received and imported the data.
lanPanel.unconfirmed.title: Sent, but Confirmation Not Received
lanPanel.unconfirmed.detail: Connection ended before the other device confirmed. Check the shelf on the other device to see if books were imported.
lanPanel.notSent.title: Transfer Incomplete
lanPanel.notSent.detail: Transfer was cancelled or not accepted. No changes were made to the other device's shelf.
lanPanel.failed.title: Transfer Failed
lanPanel.imported.title: Import Complete
lanPanel.imported.books.other: Imported {count} books. The shelf has been updated.
lanPanel.imported.books.one: Imported {count} book. The shelf has been updated.
lanPanel.imported.data: Reading data imported. The shelf has been updated.
lanPanel.closed.title: Connection Closed
lanPanel.closed.detail: The other device has disconnected. Please reconnect if you need to transfer more.
lanPanel.subtitle.idle: Transfer directly over the same Wi‑Fi without cloud servers
lanPanel.subtitle.host: Waiting for the other device to scan
lanPanel.subtitle.active: Please keep this app open on both devices
lanPanel.title: Device Transfer
lanPanel.close.label: Close Device Transfer
